name: weather-sky-simple
description: WEATHER-SKY simple rung. The sky BACKDROP follows the weather condition on both surfaces that paint it: the orbit surround dome (skySurround -> lighting/Sky.tsx) and the walk-mode window backdrop (skyGradient -> SceneBackdrop's SkyBackdrop). Runs all four conditions at 13:00 and at a low sun (18:00) in both camera modes, and at each one reads the PAINTED EQUIRECT BYTES back off the live texture -- the dome's CanvasTexture in orbit, scene.background in walk -- because a screenshot cannot tell a re-bake that ran from one that was skipped, and the orbit camera is pitched ~25 deg DOWN so the visible background is at/below the horizon, not the zenith. The walk arm turns estateSurround OFF so the backdrop is legible through the glass, then restores it for a shipped-default control.
